d:
Experience the magic of Hedwig's Theme meeting the Game of Thrones theme, performed live at our Sitar for Mental Health gathering in New York City.
Special Thanks to Sanjay Rikhiram (my father) for making me this wonderful sitar! So grateful :)
Original Songs:
Hedwig's Theme by John Williams
Game of Thrones Theme by Ramin Djawadi
Performers:
Sitar: Rishab Sharma
Tabla: Nitin Mitta
